title: Spotlight links: full titles, button or text link styles, and your own main button

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19 (project thread: Redesign the Spotlight editor): 'display different text link vs button styles. Make it easier to edit the titles and clean it all up.' Cards: a block default plus a per-link override; the owner picks the main button. Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/WX5fSWaGKNuKhe8iXbPSYf, phase 3.

detail: The Links field squeezed each title into a third of a narrow column (about 100px), so titles were cut off. Each link is now a row with its whole title and address; it opens to a full-width title, a full-width address with a check, its style and a Make this the main button switch, and the open row follows a press on that link in the preview. Pasting an address fills a first title. A link keeps an optional style (main, button, card, text; lib/entity-blocks/block-content.ts) and the block a default (linkStyle). The Links renderer draws all four in the page's own tokens; the New World layouts take the owner's main pick, with the first link as the fallback.

verify.note: Fails while titles are squeezed, link styles are dropped, or the main button is not the owner's pick.
